description:
We are looking for ColdFusion Developer in Columbia, SC for 12+ months contract position.  
 
 Please refer someone else if you are not available at this time or you are not right match for this job opportunity. We have great Referral Bonus up to $2500!!! Please don't miss to refer someone who are looking for projects. 
 
 
 Job Description: 
 Position: ColdFusion Developer 
 Location: Columbia, SC 29201 
 Duration: 12+ months 
 Client: Direct Client 
 
 DAILY DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 1. Use ColdFusion to maintain existing Certification applications used by the Office of Educator Services. 
 2. Design, develop, and deploy any modifications or required enhancements to the applications used by the Office of Educator Services. 
 3. Document all programs written or modified. 
 4. Work from the Parklane office one day a week as requested by the Director of Educator Services. 
 5. Provide weekly status reports to the Director of the Office of Educator Services and to the Director, Project & Application Management. 
 6. Work will not exceed 40 hours per week. On occasion there may be a need to exceed the weekly hours at the request of SCDE. 
 7. Each week the consultant will report a breakdown of hours spent on the project. 
 8. Participate in bi-weekly status meetings with the Director of Educator Services and Director of Project & Application Management. 
 
 REQUIRED SKILLS: 
 COLDFUSION 10 
 MS SQL 2012 
 BOOTSTRAP 3+ 
 CANVASJS 
 WEB CONTENT ACCESSIBILITY GUIDELINES (WCAG) EXPERIENCE 
 
 PREFERRED SKILLS: 
 MURA 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
